Property-Based Testing: Kiro's Secret Weapon

This testing method catches bugs your unit tests never will.
Property-based testing uses fuzz-testing style checks for correctness.
Instead of one input, it throws hundreds of edge cases at your code.
Kiro can generate these automatically from your requirements.

Episode 32 of theAIgurukul's free Kiro series, a daily short on AWS's agentic IDE. Subscribe for the next one.
